text: Celestial Tiger Guard
One of the Celestial mainstay forces, the blade of the Celestial army and the elite of the Dragon Emperor.
Celestial Dragon Guard
The Dragon Guard win every battle they fight and take every stronghold they attack, but need the cover of crossbow-and-shield formations.
Thunderbolt Gunners
Thunderbolt Gunners excel with firearms, deploying armored infantry ahead to shield them from harm.
Pioneer Scouts
Pioneer Scouts excel at surprise attacks, striking first and leaving the enemy nowhere to hide.
Rampart Terracotta Sentinels
Massed together, the terracotta warriors become unstoppable, overturning mountains and seas, overpowering all rivals.
Golden Crow Gunners
Firearms forged by Nan Gau smiths that can destroy the enemy from a thousand miles away. Wielded by the elite of the Great Bastion, every shot finds its mark.
Celestial Mighty Axe Guard
The Celestial Mighty Axe Guard bear the Dragon Emperor's mandate, with iron resolve sworn to defend Cathay's lands to the death—though not fully trained, they know but three axe strokes.
Palace Guard Battalion
The soul of Cathay's Great Bastion, a wall of shields and a forest of spears through which no foe dares pass.
Jade Crossbow Riders
Swift as the wind, measured as the forest, ravaging as fire, immovable as the mountain.
Celestial Mounted Archers
The elite of the Dragon Emperor, veterans of a thousand battles great and small, foremost among cavalry.
Celestial Imperial Guard
The Dragon Emperor's personal guard, excelling at fighting infantry, though somewhat strained against massive beasts.
Dragon-Horse Crossbow Riders
Wielding Nan Gau's divine engines, they rain arrows like a storm.
Jade Warriors (Greatsword)
The greatsword is used opposite to spear and shield—only when placed at the rear of a formation does its might truly show.
Celestial Left Guard
The Left Guard fights with paired maces, excelling at breaking heavy armor.
Celestial Divine Strategy Army
Those who wield the iron whip strike down ghosts and spirits, breaking every evil—none can rival them in exorcising the wicked.
Celestial Right Guard
Those who wield twin hammers are as gods, possessed of boundless strength. Their arms hold a valor beyond measure, crushing iron like clay, surpassing even Xiang Yu of the Han era.
Hook-Shield Guard
Those who wield the hook-shield can guard against slashing blows, but being unarmored, must avoid stray arrows.
Valiant Fruit Guards
The Valiant Fruit Guards are the imperial guard of the Grand Capital, skilled with the mace-spear and mounted combat, each worth ten men.
Nan Gau Blazing Cavalry
A divine weapon of this age, forged by Nan Gau artisans. Demons flee at the mere sight of it.
Nan Gau Divine Engine Army
A decisive weapon of war forged in Nan Gau, capable of crushing the enemy with overwhelming force.
Twin Moon Yin-Yang Envoys
Skilled with twin blades, they channel yin and yang power into their arrows—the enemy falls dead before they even see a shadow.
Nan Gau Zhu Long Guard
Deadly at range, deadly in melee. The elite of Nan Gau, who marched with Miao Ying time and again to strike at Chaos along the Great Bastion.
Five Elements Bombard Compass
Harnesses the power of the Five Elements Compass to unleash firepower rivaling a cannon.
Onyx-Armored Crow Guard
Some of the onyx-armored crow-men act like agents lurking in the dark, delivering a fatal blow when the enemy least expects it.
Rampart Watcher
Atop the Great Bastion, they watch for enemies a thousand miles distant, one watchpost every ten miles, stretching on in vast, unbroken numbers.
Sky Ark Fortress
Driven by the star-gazing power of the Si Tian Cheng, this vessel is the greatest ship in all of Cathay, though the rarity of the Si Tian Cheng means few ever witness it.
Sky Patrol Vessel
Driven by the power of the Moon-Phoenix, this sky vessel is often used to patrol the surroundings of the Great Bastion, granting keen awareness of its environs.
Celestial Lion Riders
Within the Bright Moon Forest dwell those skilled in taming the celestial lions.
